risk_note: RV2 by path (union; order data feeds commission). Corrects the merged B1-04zb per D10-529, which withdrew D10-520 item 1: BR-FUND-02 lets the adapter write settle_commission_fen only when the platform is explicitly settled, and JD's 40 official validCodes have no such code (18 does not exist). The adapter now never writes settle_commission_fen; settlement amounts come only from the union statement import into order_settlements (source=STATEMENT). est_commission_fen takes actualFee at 17 and estimateFee otherwise, negatives kept; commission_fen is max(0, est); paid_fen unchanged except 18 is no longer special. Frozen assertions pinning settle at 17 / 18 were changed by a fresh independent Claude, still exact; the orchestrator ruled #24 applies. JD stays demo and credit.enabled.jd stays off, so nobody is paid from this path.
